items.title: Trump says 'big wave' of attacks on Iran to come
items.description: US President Donald Trump has said the "big wave" of joint US and Israeli attacks on Iran is yet to come, as the Middle East conflict continues unabated. Follow live.

items.title: Live: Marles says Australians 'safe' after drone strike on Middle East ADF base
items.description: Defence Minister Richard Marles has confirmed all Australians are "safe" after a base used by the ADF in the Middle East was hit over the weekend. Follow live.

items.title: What verified videos tell us about what's unfolded in the Middle East
items.description: As the war in the Middle East escalates, ABC NEWS Verify has gathered verified video and satellite imagery in an early attempt to piece together some of the key events of the past 48 hours.

items.title: 'There will be other places': The catastrophe stalking Swiss Alps towns
items.description: The Swiss Alps are a natural wonder and a key part of the national identity, but life in the mountains is under threat from climate change.

items.title: After Iran's shock, there's a question Beijing cannot avoid
items.description: China's constitution suggests that party institutions elect the top leader. In practice, the process has always been political.

items.title: Videos of the Clintons answering questions about Epstein released
items.description: Bill Clinton told the committee that he had ended his relationship with Epstein years before the financier was found guilty of soliciting prostitution and Hillary said she never even recalled meeting him.

items.title: Forensic pathologist who watched Epstein's autopsy says suicide ruling 'absolutely wrong'
items.description: The US Department of Justice, the FBI and New York City forensic experts might have moved on from the possibility Jeffrey Epstein did not take his own life, but many have not, and now suspicions around his death have gone mainstream.

items.title: School friends shocked after 20yo Perth man charged with terror attack offences
items.description: News of Jayson Joseph Michaels being charged with acting in preparation for a "mass casualty" terror act has left his school friends in disbelief.

items.title: Redness on Trump's neck caused by common skin cream, White House says
items.description: The White House says the large red spot on US President Donald Trump's neck is due to a skin cream he is using, without elaborating on what condition it is treating.

items.title: New inner Sydney suburb to be built opposite busy cruise terminal
items.description: Thousands of foreshore homes are earmarked for a new inner Sydney suburb along the harbour, but future residents will have a bustling cruise terminal near their doorstep.

items.title: France to boost nuclear arsenal, involve European allies in deterrence
items.description: French President Emmanuel Macron has announced France will expand its nuclear arsenal and will potentially allow European partners to host its aircraft on nuclear deterrence missions.

items.title: Live: Oil rises above $US79 a barrel, Wall Street muted
items.description: Australian stocks are likely to fall after a fairly muted session on Wall Street, while crude oil prices have shot up above $US79 a barrel as conflict grips Middle East. Follow the latest updates in our live blog.

items.title: As my destination wedding loomed I knew it would ruin our lives
items.description: For Sashi, calling off a destination wedding with 250 guests was hard. But it was the start of a long journey towards learning about her mental health.

items.title: How to see tonight's 'blood moon' eclipse from Australia
items.description: All of Australia will be treated to a "blood moon" tonight wherever the sky is clear. Here's how you can catch a glimpse of the last total lunar eclipse until 2029.

items.title: ABC Timelines quiz: Test your memory of the 2020s ... so far
items.description: We're back with the second part of our test of your memory of some of the major events of the 2020s in pop culture, sport and world news. Your challenge is to pick which happened first.

items.title: Meet the $235,000 bull that dazzled buyers with his good looks
items.description: Perfect skin, good looks and a sparkling personality may sound like a romantic partner wish list, but this is what buyers are after when selecting a "complete" bull.

items.title: Why you should think twice before jumping on the AI caricature trend
items.description: Amateur artist Anne Rowlands lost all her commissions in the past year and says the rise of AI-generated "art" is to blame.

items.title: Vice-president of national farming body refuses to resign over 'unacceptable' posts
items.description: The National Farmers' Federation board has asked its vice-president to reconsider his position after he made "unacceptable" social media posts.

items.title: RBA governor says 'too early to say' how Middle East war will impact Australia
items.description: Michelle Bullock says events are moving rapidly and there are different ways the war could play out, with RBA staff closely monitoring the situation.

items.title: Australia's gender pay gap has narrowed. See where your employer stands
items.description: Is your employer among the those with the largest or smallest gender pay gaps? More than 5.9 million workers from over 10,000 employers can now see the data for themselves.

items.title: Child missing for three hours from after-school program, documents reveal
items.description: Regulator documents expose supervision failures, injuries, and claims of profit-driven budget cuts at TeamKids and Camp Australia out-of-school care services in the ACT.

items.title: A year on from Qld floods, retirees say insurance woes have upended golden years
items.description: It was meant to be their retirement dream, but north Queenslanders have been out of their homes for over a year awaiting flood insurance repairs.

items.title: Queensland government's 11th-hour changes to hate speech laws after criticism
items.description: The Crisafulli government has introduced last-minute changes to it's hate speech laws after widespread criticism.

items.title: 'Just vile': Police probe fourth offensive letter threatening mosque
items.description: A three-page "essay of condemnation" addressed to a leader of the Sydney Muslim community has sparked renewed fears of escalating threats of violence.

items.title: Cyclone could form this week as Queensland rivers rise 'like a yo-yo'
items.description: A tropical low has formed in the northern Coral Sea, while regional communities throughout Queensland are on flood watch.
